description: Add an optional motor variant to the gripper: the gripper base can alternatively be driven by the SO-101 arm's motor, the Feetech STS3215 servo, instead of the RobStride RS00. Make the motor a selectable parameter (motor = RS00 | STS3215) with the right mount, gear or horn interface and cable routing for each, built on the latest Base (see AGENTS.md hardware notes and the Gripper/Handle/Base scheme). Also record joint positions from the STS3215 servo while the gripper is used by hand, for data collection.
summary: The gripper base design only supports the RobStride RS00 motor, and there is no option to use the SO-101 arm's Feetech STS3215 servo. Add a selectable motor parameter (RS00 or STS3215) with the correct mount, horn interface and cable routing, built on the latest Base, and record STS3215 joint positions during hand use for data collection.
